hypothesis: max-plus nonlinear critical-path selection loses source cost covariance when one median per node is replayed. Equal-weight full source-iteration scenarios may preserve variation without target fitting.
members: independent per-iteration F/B phase and local runtime costs plus per-iteration latent PP readiness fits
point_estimate: arithmetic mean of scenario envelope predictions; not replay of mean costs
uncertainty: min/max of two or four exposed source scenarios, not confidence or prediction intervals; no target-dependent quantile choice
target_exposure: All target metrics and lane0 profiles already seen in earlier diagnostics; target rank-event table pinned and schema inspected after v687 seal. None enters source fitting. New target results are development evaluation only.
posthoc_diagnostic: after prediction seal, lane0 four disjoint GPU components are substituted in all 16 subsets; exact Shapley effects sum to target-assisted component counterfactual difference. Do not call this a prediction or full-rank attribution.
model_selection: source mechanism and incremental validation; no search for desired target error
